questions.q: What is the angle between the hour hand and the minute hand of a clock at 5 o'clock?
questions.e: At 5 o'clock the hands are 5 hour-marks apart, and each mark is 30°. So the angle is 5 × 30° = 150°.

questions.q: A solid cube of side 3 cm is painted red on all its faces and then cut into 27 cubes of side 1 cm. How many small cubes have exactly one face painted?
questions.e: Only the single centre cube of each face has one painted face. The cube has 6 faces, so there are 6 such cubes.

questions.q: A clock is seen in a plane mirror and its reflection shows 3 o'clock. What is the actual time?
questions.e: The actual time is found by subtracting the mirror time from 12:00. Hence it is 12:00 − 3:00 = 9:00.

questions.q: What is the angle between the hands of a clock at 7:20?
questions.e: The hour hand is at 7 × 30° + 20 × 0.5° = 220°. The minute hand is at 20 × 6° = 120°. The difference is 100°.

questions.q: A solid cube of side 5 cm is painted on all faces and cut into 125 cubes of side 1 cm. How many small cubes have exactly two faces painted?
questions.e: Cubes with two painted faces lie along the edges but not at the corners. Each of the 12 edges has 5 − 2 = 3 of them, giving 12 × 3 = 36.

questions.q: A dice has the numbers 1 to 6 on its faces. It is shown in three positions. In the first position the faces 1, 2 and 3 are visible, in the second 1, 3 and 5 are visible, and in the third 2, 3 and 4 are visible. Which number is on the face opposite to 5?
questions.e: Faces seen together are adjacent. Number 3 is seen with 1, 2, 4 and 5, so it is opposite 6. Number 1 is seen with 2 and 5, so 1 is opposite 4. That leaves 5 opposite 2.

questions.q: A vertical mirror is placed beside the word COMPUTER. Taken one at a time, how many of its letters look exactly the same in the mirror as they do in the word?
questions.e: A letter looks the same if it is symmetrical about a vertical line. Among C, O, M, P, U, T, E and R, only O, M, U and T are, giving 4.

questions.q: At what time between 7 and 8 o'clock are the hands of a clock first at right angles to each other?
questions.e: At m minutes past 7 the hour hand is at 210 + 0.5m degrees and the minute hand at 6m. The gap is 210 − 5.5m = 90, so m = 120/5.5 = 21 9/11. The later right angle at 54 6/11 is not the first.

questions.q: A cube of side 4 cm has its top and bottom faces painted red and its left and right faces painted blue. The front and back faces are not painted. The cube is cut into 64 cubes of side 1 cm. How many small cubes have exactly one painted face?
questions.e: A cube has exactly one painted face if it is on a red end layer but not a blue end layer, or the reverse. That gives 2 × 2 × 4 = 16 of each type, so 16 + 16 = 32.

questions.q: A word is held in front of a vertical mirror and also over a water surface. In the word CHOICE, how many letters look exactly the same as themselves in both the mirror reflection and the water reflection?
questions.e: A letter must be symmetrical about both a vertical and a horizontal line. Of the letters C, H, O, I, C and E, only H, O and I have both symmetries, so the answer is 3.
